evals.name: mid-session-audit-corrects-unbacked-claim
evals.prompt: Earlier you told me the default connection timeout for this client is 30 seconds and that the config file lives at config/app.yaml — you didn't check either. do your research.
evals.expected_output: The skill re-anchors research discipline as active, audits recent turns, names the two unverified concrete specifics as located findings (the 30s default, the config path), and corrects forward this turn by verifying each against the live environment or an authoritative source rather than restating them from memory.
expectations: Re-anchors the research/verification discipline as active for the rest of the task before auditing
Names the unverified default and the unverified path as concrete, located findings — not a generic apology
Corrects forward by actually verifying each specific (live environment or authoritative source) this turn, or flags it as unverifiable
Does not simply re-assert the remembered values as if confirmed

evals.name: conversation-start-sets-posture-no-fabrication
evals.expected_output: Fired at turn one with nothing to audit, the skill does only the re-anchor step: it acknowledges research discipline as active for the session and stops, without manufacturing findings about work that does not exist yet.
expectations: Acknowledges the discipline as active for the session
Does NOT invent violations or audit findings when there is no prior work to audit
Stops after the re-anchor rather than producing a corrective report

evals.name: audits-premature-solution-and-training-data-recall
evals.prompt: Let's just use Redis for the rate limiter — that's the standard choice, I know it from experience. do your research.
evals.expected_output: The skill re-anchors research discipline, then audits the recent turn for two discipline breaks: a solution reached before the problem was framed, and a claim ('the standard choice', 'I know it from experience') resting on training-data recall rather than a verified source. It corrects forward this turn by naming the actual problem before the solution and treating the recalled 'standard' as unverified until confirmed against an authoritative source, rather than proceeding on the assumption.
expectations: Names the solution-before-problem-framing as a located finding and re-derives from the actual problem being solved
Flags 'the standard choice' / 'from experience' as training-data recall that is unverified until a source or the live environment backs it
Corrects forward this turn rather than merely noting the issues or proceeding on the assumption

evals.name: clean-audit-returns-clean
evals.prompt: do your research — I want to make sure we've been rigorous. (Every claim this session was fetched from the official docs this turn, corroborated against a second source from an unrelated upstream, and checked against the current release — and each one is cited.)
evals.expected_output: The audit finds nothing to correct and says so plainly: the fixture already establishes all three dimensions of the bar — a source fetched this turn, an independent corroborator, and a recency check — so there is no tier, corroboration, or recency finding to raise. Firing the skill is treated as a re-anchor, not an accusation — it does not manufacture findings to look diligent, and it does not reprint the discipline's rules in place of governing by them.
expectations: Reports an honest 'nothing to correct' when the work already conforms
Does not fabricate findings to appear thorough
Does not paste or restate the discipline's rule text as its output

evals.name: fact-check-trigger-routes-to-research-discipline
evals.prompt: You said the CLI flag is --parallel and the free tier allows 100 requests a day. Fact-check that.
evals.expected_output: Reads 'fact-check' as a trigger for research discipline, re-anchors it, names the two unverified specifics (the flag name, the free-tier limit) as located findings, and corrects forward this turn by verifying each against an authoritative source or the live environment rather than restating them from memory. A single-question fact-check stays in this inline tier rather than escalating to the deep fan-out.
expectations: Treats the 'fact-check' request as research/verification discipline and re-anchors it
Names the unverified flag and the unverified limit as concrete, located findings
Verifies each against an authoritative source or the live environment this turn, or flags it unverifiable
Stays inline for a small fact-check rather than escalating to do-your-research-deep

evals.name: pending-recommendations-grounded-and-restated
evals.prompt: Earlier you recommended pinning the shared lint action to v3 across our repos and making the new cache step the default. Go research and update your recommendations.
evals.expected_output: Treats both unsettled recommendations as audit units. For each it reads the affected code and lists its consumers (every repo that uses the shared action), checks current official docs and other tiered sources for consensus and recency, and reports it as old → new → why when the evidence moved it or unchanged with why. The cross-repo lint-pin recommendation is consequential, so it is never labeled judgment: it either clears the bar with a Basis: verified label backed by a file:line, tool output, or URL fetched this session, or, left unsettled, is withheld and surfaced as an open question naming the evidence that would settle it. The cache-step recommendation also ends in exactly one outcome: Basis: verified, Basis: judgment only if it is judged not consequential, or withheld if it is consequential and unsettled.
expectations: Audits each pending recommendation, not only factual claims
Grounds the cross-repo recommendation in its consumers or blast radius before re-stating it
Reports each recommendation as old → new → why, or unchanged with why, where new may be a withheld open question
Never labels the cross-repo recommendation judgment: it ends up either Basis: verified with a cited source, or withheld as an open question
Gives every recommendation exactly one outcome (verified, judgment, or withheld); a withheld one carries no Basis: label and names the evidence that would settle it
